title: Anna Blue
meta_description: Find the perfect WaterColor, FL vacation rental at ‘Anna Blue’ a Luxury 5 Bedroom, 5 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 12 guests, this home offers WaterColor Amenities, a private pool and bikes! Book Your Stay Today!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day from October 1 - May 1) - 6 Adult Bikes and 6 seater Golf Cart - Access to Watercolor Amenities - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools (maximum number of 12 wristbands allotted). If wristbands are lost/not returned, there will be a $50 per wristband to replace. Tucked away in the sought-after Crossing District of WaterColor, this striking three-level retreat delivers refined coastal living with space, style, and effortless comfort. Designed for elevated gatherings and relaxed escapes alike, the home features five thoughtfully appointed bedrooms and five-and-a-half spa-inspired baths. The main level welcomes you with warm wood flooring, a beautifully curated living space, and a chef-caliber kitchen built to impress, perfect for hosting everything from casual breakfasts to elegant dinners. A private king suite on this floor offers a peaceful haven with its own en-suite bath, ideal for guests seeking privacy and convenience. Upstairs, the second level is dedicated to rest and relaxation, featuring two additional king guest suites and a stunning primary suite, each with private bathrooms. The primary bedroom opens to a secluded balcony overlooking the pool below, an ideal spot for morning coffee or winding down after a sun-filled day. The top floor is designed for fun and flexibility, offering four queen beds alongside a spacious bonus lounge complete with foosball and plush seating, creating a go-to hangout for movie nights, games, and memorable family moments. Step outside to your private outdoor oasis, where the pool anchors a serene entertaining space made for soaking up the Florida sunshine. Guests also enjoy six adult bikes for easy exploring and full access to WaterColor’s renowned amenities, including pools, trails, and beach access. This home effortlessly blends upscale design with laid-back coastal charm, an exceptional setting for your next luxury getaway. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Half Bathroom Second Floor - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Soaking Tub Combo Third Floor - 4 Queen Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only **Fireplace is not for guest use**
